newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MONDAY MIXED ON UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MONDAY MIXED ON UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted mixed against hard currencies after Monday's interbank session which saw exchange rates holding on to their opening levels in thin trade, dealers said.
"Today was a very quiet day and our dollar didn't move from its opening levels against other units," a dealer said.
At Monday's close, the local unit was quoted unchanged at Friday's 10.2500/2700 on the U.S. dollar, but was firmer against pound sterling at 15.9100/9600 compared to 15.9390/9800.
It was also edged up versus the mark to 6.7800/8000 from 6.7820/7960 but eased to 2.2800/2900 against South Africa's rand from 2.2780/2840.
